name: WebSLM
description: Private AI that runs on your own computer: open small language models in your browser with llama.cpp (WebAssembly/WebGPU). No install, works offline.

paragraphs: WebSLM is a free, open-source chat app for small language models (SLMs) that runs entirely in your web browser. It uses llama.cpp, compiled to WebAssembly and WebGPU through wllama, so the model runs on your own laptop or desktop. There is no chat server: your messages, files and answers are processed and stored on your device.
Small models are good at everyday language work such as rewriting, summarizing, explaining and drafting. They are not the largest cloud models, and they can be wrong, so check anything important.
features: Private by design. Prompts, answers and attached files never leave the browser. Chats are saved locally and can be exported.

20 light open models. From 150 MB to 1.9 GB, by Google, Microsoft, Meta, IBM, Mistral AI, Alibaba Qwen, Liquid AI and Hugging Face. Each file is verified before it's offered, with its size and licence shown.
Fits your device. The app checks WebGPU, memory and free storage, suggests a model that fits and flags any that may be slow. Remove models at any time.
Fast where it counts. Uses WebGPU when available and multi-threaded WebAssembly otherwise. Small models run on the CPU by default, which is faster on integrated graphics.
Your documents. Attach PDF, Word (.docx) and text files. The browser reads them; nothing is uploaded.

requirements.text: Sign in with your email (free, no password) before your first download.

The app lists light, open models that run in a browser tab on a laptop or desktop. scripts/build-catalog.mjs checks each one on Hugging Face: the file exists, needs no account, is a chat model, fits under about 1.95 GB, and its architecture runs in this engine.
